collect.//: IERD-Q6 network_TTFB regression gate. Builds the real Next app and serves it; Lighthouse drives headless Chrome against the public /signin route (static prerender, no auth redirect) so the network_TTFB and client_render budgets are measured against a genuine production server — not faked.

assert.//: §5 latency budgets. server-response-time IS the network_TTFB layer (origin TTFB) and MUST fail the build on violation (< 300 ms). first-contentful-paint is the client_render budget (< 1.0 s). LCP/CLS optional (warn). The TTFB / FCP assertions are the load-bearing, fail-closed gate for issue #531.
